ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rootsy songwriting fits my interests, but I would pass this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Enjoying Benmont Tench makes me interested in more music from Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers; this is my pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and guitar-driven rock right now than standards.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Memphis makes another Boz Scaggs album appealing, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Band of Brothers; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Willie Nelson's songwriting interests me, though I am choosing rock this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Freedom: Atlanta Pop Festival; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: People, Hell & Angels makes live Hendrix appealing, but I am not looking for a concert album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sons of Anarchy: Songs of Anarchy: Volume 2 Original Soundtrack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A soundtrack feels less relevant than another album by an artist I already follow.
ItemID: NA; Title: Quiet About It: A Tribute To Jesse Winchester; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have enough interest in Jesse Winchester to choose a tribute album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Django and Jimmie; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country direction has some appeal given Blown Away, but it is not my priority this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Born To Play Guitar; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my interest in Clapton and Hendrix, but I would leave this for another visit.
